title: Mavria, which aims to build modular data centers that can be shipped by trucks, raised $130M across pre-seed and seed rounds at a $1B valuation led by Paradigm (Jennifer Hiller/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Jennifer Hiller / Wall Street Journal: Mavria, which aims to build modular data centers that can be shipped by trucks, raised $130M across pre-seed and seed rounds at a $1B valuation led by Paradigm — Mavria has raised money at a $1 billion valuation to build modular data centers that can be shipped by truck
